general.enabled.description: Whether to start the jamnntpd daemon automatically.

general.interface.description: Network interface or IP address to bind the server to. Use '0.0.0.0' to listen on all interfaces.

general.log_level.description: Verbosity of logs: 0 = quiet, 5 = debug. Recommended: 3 (info).

general.sync_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between automatic time synchronization attempts.

server.port.description: UDP port to listen on for NTP client requests. Must be 123 for standard NTP.

server.max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

server.broadcast_enabled.description: Enable or disable broadcast/multicast time announcements to local subnet.

server.broadcast_peers.description: List of broadcast/multicast peer groups (e.g., subnet addresses) to announce time to.

name.description: Descriptive label for this peer group.

interval.description: Interval (seconds) between broadcasts to this group.

server.peers.description: List of trusted NTP peers (servers) to synchronize with.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the NTP peer server.

key_id.description: Key ID used for cryptographic authentication with this peer (0 = none).

security.auth_enabled.description: Enable cryptographic authentication for client and peer connections.

security.keys_file.description: Absolute path to the NTP keys file (used only if auth is enabled).

security.trusted_key.description: Key ID to trust for server authentication (must exist in keys_file).

leap_seconds.leapfile.description: Absolute path to leap seconds data file (optional, auto-downloaded if empty).

leap_seconds.auto_leap.description: Automatically insert leap seconds at 23:59:60 UTC on designated dates.
